source: The Deep Design Document.pdf: phase overview (pp. 2-4), Gathering, hunting, and weapons (pp. 11-14), Crafting, resources, and upgrades (pp. 120-135), biome flora tables (via species_shallows.json / species_kelp.json and p. 36)

notes: The doc gives no maximums or drain rates for any personal meter; every number below is a restore, buff or duration taken from a recipe or rule.

Hunger and thirst ('hydration') are restored by Pressure Grill food and Hydro-Juicer drinks in steps of +10 to +50 (e.g. Abyssal Sushi Roll +50 hunger +10 hydration; Silt-Sifter Shake +50 hunger but -10 hydration).

Water: the Thermal Desalinator slowly boils seawater, 2 minutes per Distilled Water (+20 hydration); the Bio-Osmosis Filter instantly turns toxic or salty water into Purified Water (+40 hydration). Purification progresses from slow boiling to fast biological filtering.
Raw fish can cause food poisoning; the Pressure Grill sears meat and prevents it.

Oxygen: the Airlock & Dive Room manages oxygen tanks, dive suits and tethers. With the sub Dead in the Water (full shutdown), life support and lights go off, oxygen slowly drops and the interior cools and freezes.

Breath: Hyper-Oxygenate Syringe triples maximum breath for 15 min. Kelp flora: Bulb Gas refills O2 tanks, Gasp Bladder gives emergency air. City Resonance Crystal's 'Steadfast' slows panic and oxygen drain while in the room.

Stamina: Charred Scavenger Crab lowers stamina drain for 5 min; Cavern Cold-Brew means no stamina drain for 60 s; Stalker's Frenzy Injector gives zero stamina cost (and +50% Heated Blade attack speed) for 3 min with red-tinted blurred vision; sleeping in the Galleon Captain's Bed gives 'Well Rested' (+10% max stamina); a Grazer-Hide Hammock gives the normal sleep buff.
Core temperature: Kelp-Grazer Broth gives internal insulation so core temperature drops much more slowly in freezing currents. The Void Edge drains diver suit heat; a shut-down sub freezes inside.

Health and damage: Heated Blade cauterizes wounds on hit; Chitin-Plated Dive Suit cancels impact damage from high-speed collisions and cuts bite damage by 40%; Iron-Kelp Smoothie gives temporary +15% physical damage resistance. Basic medkits come from Verdant Chlorophyll Paste and Moss Sap (flora uses).
Venom/poison: Marrow Anti-Toxin instantly cures venom (such as Reef-Snapper bites) and gives 3 min poison immunity.
Radiation/heavy metals: swimming too close to the dreadnought's breached boilers causes radiation sickness or heavy-metal poisoning; the Heavy-Metal Chelation Syringe cures it instantly.
Nausea: chemical vents cause nausea; Silt-Sifter Shake gives 5 min immunity.

Pressure: the dive suit has a crush depth (value not given); the Abyssal Pressure-Seal lets a diver survive 100 m below it for exactly 90 s before catastrophic barotrauma; the Pressure Exosuit survives far past dive-suit crush depth. The Nautilus's crush depth is set by its hull upgrade.
Blinding: Flash-Retina Drops give 10 min immunity to the Flash-Stalker's strobe (about 50,000 lux).
Light buff: Luminescent Nectar makes veins glow, a faint 15 m personal light for 10 min.

meters.name: Oxygen / breath
meters.notes: Max breath can be tripled for 15 min (Hyper-Oxygenate Syringe). Tanks managed in the Airlock & Dive Room; O2 tank refills from Bulb Gas; Gasp Bladder emergency air. Inside the sub, oxygen slowly drops when Dead in the Water. 'Steadfast' slows oxygen drain.

meters.name: Hunger
meters.notes: Restored +20 to +50 per meal (see food items). Raw fish risks food poisoning unless grilled.

meters.name: Hydration (thirst)
meters.notes: Distilled Water +20, Purified Water +40, juicer drinks +10 to +40; Silt-Sifter Shake costs 10.

meters.name: Health
meters.notes: Damage from bites, collisions, venom, radiation/heavy metals, barotrauma. Chitin-Plated Dive Suit -40% bite damage; Iron-Kelp Smoothie +15% physical resistance; Heated Blade cauterizes wounds.

meters.name: Stamina
meters.notes: Drained by exertion. Well Rested +10% max stamina; Cold-Brew 60 s no drain; Charred Scavenger Crab lowers drain 5 min; Stalker's Frenzy zero stamina cost 3 min.

meters.name: Core temperature
meters.notes: Drops in freezing currents, in a shut-down sub, and from Void Edge heat-draining leeches. Kelp-Grazer Broth slows the drop.

meters.name: Pressure (crush depth)
meters.notes: Below the dive suit's crush depth the diver suffers barotrauma; Abyssal Pressure-Seal grants 100 m extra for exactly 90 s. Pressure Exosuit goes far deeper.

toolTiers.notes: Soft flora, early tangles (Tangle Vines, ordinary kelp fouling a propeller), small predators.
Starter Drill: tier 2 mineral nodes and hard flora (Titanium Ore, coral rods, copper and quartz nodes). Heated Blade: Iron-Kelp stalks and tangles, thick woody flora.
Mid-Tier Drill: tier 3 nodes, abyssal calcium deposits, Diamond Clusters, Fossilized Leviathan Ribs. Mk II: crystal and petrified flora (Crystal Reef, Drowned Forest tier 3).
Not a numbered tier in the doc: 'the deepest tier 3 deposits in the Graveyard and Void need the Mining Laser' (Crypt Spire, Monolith Cap, Void-Crystal veins).

estimated: Survival meter maximums and drain rates are not in the doc. hunger/thirst max 100 is inferred from the +10..+50 restore values; every drainPerMin is null.

Starter Drill and Spear Gun (phase 1) are listed under 'Gear (Abyssal Forge)', but the Abyssal Forge is a phase 2 unlock and costs Table Coral Slab, which needs the Starter Drill. Their station is set to Fabrication Bay to break the loop.
Thermal Desalinator is a phase 1 unlock, but its cost includes 1 Iron-Kelp Stalk, which is a Kelp Labyrinth resource cut with the Heated Blade (phase 2). Phase kept at 1 as the doc says.

Phases for components, stations and recipes not given a phase in the doc (Bio-Polymer Glue, High-Tensile Mesh, Kelp-Grazer Lubricant, Synthetic Fuel Canister, Bio-Osmosis Filter, Hydro-Juicer, Artisan Bench, all food/drink, the elixirs except the station's phase 3, all Artisan Bench items) are the phase of their latest ingredient or station.
Hydro-Juicer phase 1: its cost is all phase 1 material; the doc does not say when it unlocks.
Charred Scavenger Crab and Silt-Sifter Shake need Raw Scavenger Meat from the Abyssal Graveyard, so they are phase 8 even though their names sound early.

Station rooms: the doc says stations are modular (placed with the Magnetic Hand-Welder). Assigning Desalinator, Filter, Grill, Juicer and Distiller to Hydroponics & Larder (which does cooking and water purification) and the Forge and Artisan Bench to the Fabrication Bay is inferred.
Hull upgrades' station (Fabrication Bay, 'ship parts') and vehicles' station (Moonpool) are inferred.
Kelp-Grazer Lubricant and Synthetic Fuel Canister station: the components table says 'Hydroponics Bay' for the lubricant; the fuel's station is inferred from the room description.
Steam engine repair counts (1 Titanium, 1 Synthetic Fuel Canister) are placeholders: the doc says only 'repaired with Titanium and Synthetic Fuel Canisters'.
Flares, Flashbangs, Acoustic Decoy Buoys, Chum Buckets, the Mineral detector and gravity traps / bait cages have no recipe or phase in the doc.

Gathering tools for Shallows/Kelp flora not listed in the appendix's source table come from the flora tier rule (1 knife or hand, 2 Starter Drill or Heated Blade, 3 Mid-Tier Drill or Heated Blade Mk II).

Tools for fauna yields not in the appendix table (most Shallows and Kelp animal parts) are inferred (Spear Gun / traps; apex parts 'collected, not hunted' per the doc's pillar). Their 'use' is 'No listed recipe'.

Spindle Needle: its flora (Spindle Tendril) is tier 3, which by the tier rule needs the Mid-Tier Drill or Heated Blade Mk II, but the appendix groups it under 'Knife to Heated Blade' and it is needed for the phase 3 Passive Sonar Headset. Tool set to Heated Blade.

Appendix rows that span several tools ('Knife to Heated Blade', 'Knife to Mid-Tier Drill') were narrowed per resource using the flora tier where known (Glow-Bulb, Bracket Latex t1 knife; Holdfast Resin, Strangle Sponge Filter, Bark Pod Kernel t2 Heated Blade; Bioluminescent Nectar, Crystal-Moss Shard t2; Lumen Filament Thread t1). Deeper-biome rows keep the doc's range and tier null.
Resource-to-source pairing within a multi-item appendix row (e.g. Ash Ceramic Powder <- Ash Spire, Siphon Coil <- Heat-Siphon Tubeworm Flora) follows the list order in the doc.
Resource 'kind' for some deep sources (Knot-Hole Barnacle, sponges, Osedax colonies, Solenoid Filament, Petrified Silk Cable) is inferred from the name.

Tier 3 for Crypt Iron Ore, Monolith Ceramic Core, Singularity Shard, Crystal-Root Core, Solenoid Coil, Diamond Grit, Fossilized Leviathan Rib and the Crystal Reef flora yields is inferred from the tool (Mining Laser / Mid-Tier Drill / Mk II). toolTiers entry 4 (Mining Laser) is not a numbered tier in the doc.
Monolith Ceramic Core: the appendix gives the Abyssal Graveyard (Monolith Cap) as its biome, the phase overview lists it as a phase 9 resource; phase 9, biome graveyard used.
Singularity Shard is named 'Singularity Shard (Void-Crystal)' in the appendix; recipes call it 'Singularity Shard'.
Copper and quartz nodes in the kelp clearings are mentioned (phase 2 unlock list, Starter Drill table) but their yields are never named, so they are not listed as resources.
